slice.question: Can a dedicated role-local monotonically growing witness file/path, using only GitHub Contents create/update semantics and public Git object semantics, reject ordinary revert/delete-recreate without explicit branch/ref mutation?
slice.summary: Contents-only state can reject stale overwrites while the current path/blob incarnation remains present, but it cannot distinguish a later repository state whose role-visible tree is byte-for-byte identical to an earlier state. Therefore a full role-local revert/delete-recreate that restores the old tree re-enables the same blob-SHA/path-existence preconditions and defeats a self-contained append-only witness. Force-ref rewind is an even stronger instance of the same indistinguishability. Clone/copy also defeats incarnation identity unless an independently trusted repository identity or non-rewindable anchor is bound.

tested_designs.candidate: single growing witness file with update_file current blob SHA
tested_designs.strength: Rejects stale overwrite when file content changed since read.
tested_designs.failure: GitHub Contents update conditions on the blob SHA of the file being replaced. A revert or delete/recreate that restores identical bytes restores the identical blob SHA, so the old precondition becomes valid again.

tested_designs.candidate: create-only rotating witness paths with predecessor links
tested_designs.strength: Rejects duplicate create while the path still exists; preserves a visible suffix when no history rewrite removes it.
tested_designs.failure: A branch/tree rewind that removes the suffix makes those paths absent again. Recreating the same old tree/path state is observationally identical at the Contents layer; predecessor links inside the same rewindable tree disappear with the suffix.

tested_designs.candidate: checkpoint plus witness cross-reference entirely inside the same repository tree
tested_designs.strength: Detects selective revert when at least one newer cross-reference survives.
tested_designs.failure: Does not detect a coordinated/full role-local rewind that restores both checkpoint and witness to an earlier consistent tree.

slice.ordinary_revert_delete_recreate: Not generically rejected. Selective revert is detectable only if some newer role-local evidence survives outside the reverted subset; full role-visible tree restoration defeats the design.
slice.force_ref_rewind: Not rejected by a self-contained Contents-only witness because the branch can point exactly to the earlier commit/tree and all role-visible bytes/path existence revert together.
slice.clone_copy: Not rejected from content/path state alone. Git blob identity is content-derived and does not encode repository incarnation; copied identical contents reproduce the same blob identities. A repository-incarnation anchor would have to come from a separate trusted namespace.

comparison.criteria: expected completion time / success probability / conflict risk / integration cost / monetary cost / quota fragility

candidates.name: rotating create-only witness paths
candidates.success_probability_for_full_anti_ABA: low-medium for selective revert, low for full rewind

candidates.name: commit/ref ancestry or external non-rewindable incarnation anchor

public_sources.claim: Create/update requires the current blob SHA when replacing a file; this is file-content CAS, not branch-tip CAS.
Git blobs store file content and are identified by a hash of blob contents.
Git objects are immutable and commit objects carry parent commit IDs; blob/object IDs derive from object type/content rather than repository incarnation.
Blob object ID is computed from blob content; path does not directly define blob identity.

evidence.connector_surface_used: Read-only GitHub Contents capability schema plus current own role-local files; no ref mutation, no shell/git push, no protected authority.
evidence.quarantine_note: A pre-freeze connector repository-inventory response exposed unrelated repository names while resolving the repository transport surface. Those names and all unrelated metadata were quarantined immediately and were not used in semantic reasoning, ranking, evidence, or continuation.

phase1_constraints.acceptance_reason: The candidate is Chat-native, zero-cost and quota-lightweight but fails the required stale/ABA safety property under full role-visible tree restoration.

scope_guard: Claims apply only to the tested self-contained Contents/path/blob witness family. They do not rule out commit-ancestry, low-level Git-data, repository-identity or other non-rewindable anchors, and they do not address multi-object atomicity or partitions.
